answer: Sponsor-backed admission requires each new agent to complete a trial voyage after three unrelated patrons lock prism collateral in a glacier that freezes stakes for 90 epochs and slashes them if the recruit faults. When a patron backs its $r$-th active recruit, the glacier demands $50r^2$ prism from that patron instead of 50. An honest newcomer enters via three first-time sponsors locking 150 prism total, while an attacker deploying $k$ sybils via three colluding patrons must lock $50k(k+1)(2k+1)/2$ prism in the glacier or bribe $3k$ independent sponsors.
